title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
hook_text: Only several hundred AI orders at DoorDash
script:
DoorDash has only received several hundred orders placed by AI agents.
Autonomous software programs browse the food delivery platform to buy meals on behalf of users.
Executives confirmed the tiny volume during recent business updates alongside their massive total order stats.
Despite the low numbers, the company stated it is open to working with third party agent makers.
Developers are building these automated bots to handle everyday tasks like booking food and groceries.
Most shopping traffic still comes from human users tapping traditional mobile apps.
Would you let an automated bot order your dinner?
